linked_issues.title: Deleted assets remain in .web/public and subsequent production exports

unresolved.first_comment: P1: When a generated directory replaces an app asset while the source file remains and is later edited, this call can fail the compile: `update_directory_tree` copies into the directory and `record_copy` fingerprints the directory. Handle destination type mismatches before copying, preserving the replacement or replacing it safely without fingerprinting a directory. Prompt for AI agents ```text Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At reflex/compiler/utils.py, line 1160: When a generated directory replaces an app asset while the source file remains and is later edited, this call can fail the compile: `update_directory_tree` copies into the directory and `record_copy` fingerprints the directory. Handle destination type mismatches before copying, preserving the replacement or replacing it safely without fingerprinting a directory. @@ -994,56 +995,176 @@ def resolve_path_of_web_dir(path: str | Path) -> Path: + path + ) + + path_ops.update_directory_tree(assets, public, on_copy=record_copy) + # Adopt old copies from their source, never from skipped plugin output. + for relative in current - fingerprints.keys(): ```

P2: When two production compiles share `.web`, this destructive sync can interleave with the other compile and delete or preserve assets using stale source and manifest state. Serialize the complete shared-workspace build around this call, rather than relying only on the manifest’s atomic replacement. (Based on your team's feedback about serializing shared production builds.) [View Feedback](https://www.cubic.dev/ai-review?tab=learnings&feedbackId=79fab254-a344-4c37-9717-b10faa31ef88&repo=557075997) Prompt for AI agents ```text Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At reflex/compiler/compiler.py, line 1432: When two production compiles share `.web`, this destructive sync can interleave with the other compile and delete or preserve assets using stale source and manifest state. Serialize the complete shared-workspace build around this call, rather than relying only on the manifest’s atomic replacement. (Based on your team's feedback about serializing shared production builds.) @@ -1427,13 +1427,9 @@ def compile_app( - src=assets_src, - dest=Path.cwd() / prerequisites.get_web_dir() / constants.Dirs.PUBLIC, - ) + utils._sync_app_assets() save_tasks

**Unexplained timestamp duration** The test subtracts `10_000_000_000` nanoseconds without a comment explaining the duration in human-readable terms. The repository requires that explanation for time-based calculations before merging. The later timestamp adjustment and the replacement-copy test use the same pattern. **Rule Used:** When using time-based calculations in code, include comments that explain the time duration in human-readable terms (e.g., '# 2 days in milli'). ([source](https://app.greptile.com/reflex-org-2/-/custom-context?memory=f12765cb-0537-4be8-81ad-061314e0e5d0)) **Learned From** [reflex-dev/flexgen#2190](https://github.com/reflex-dev/flexgen/pull/2190) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

recent_comments.excerpt: Confidence Score: 4/5 **[Medium risk]** Changes how app assets are copied during compilation\. The asset cleanup appears safe to merge after the test’s timestamp comments satisfy the repository requirement. Findings 1.  **Unexplained timestamp duration** ▶ Summary The PR tracks copied app assets in a fingerprint manifest and removes copies of deleted assets during later compiles while preserving changed or plugin-generated public files. - Adds coverage for renames, directory removal, replacement files, symlinks, and dry runs. - Documents the one-time cleanup needed for assets that were stale before tracking began.
